text:
Priya: noticing a host-side CPU tail after the kernel-selector tweak on canary. p99 up ~10%. traces point to tokenization + frame churn.

Marco: can you paste the quick perf snapshot?

Ellen: short perf top from the canary node:
```
# perf top -p <pid>
 24.1% tokenize::tokenize_input
 17.6% http2::hpack_encode
 13.4% stream_chunker::emit_small
 9.8% kv_store::evict
 6.2% grpc::writev
```

Diego: kv evicts increasing is interesting. suspect kernel placement splits warm KV across workers so we see more cold reads and extra parsing.

Priya: i reproduced locally at 2k rps with short sequences. With new selector avg write syscalls/request ~3.4 vs baseline ~1.0. KV hit-rate drops ~8% during warmup.

Marco: that syscall spike explains hpack churn and http2 CPU. Two low-risk experiments: 1) affinity-aware warmup in the selector (prefer kernels with existing shard residency for first N requests), 2) ingress coalescer to merge small token frames into fewer writev calls (max delay 2ms).

Ellen: also consider slightly increasing short-seq batching watermark to reduce premature kernel switches (8 -> 14 tokens). Less churn, fewer kernel rebinds.

Diego: perf-bot flagged this: https://perf.redwood/trace/3712345678. Alert: host CPU p99 +10%, kv-evict-rate +6%.

Priya: action list: rollback canary selector to old policy (Marco), run A/B: control=v2 current, variant=v2+affinity+coalesce (Ellen+Diego), capture flamegraphs and syscall traces (Priya). Add alerts for kv-evict + writev/sec during rollouts.

Marco: rolling rollback now. will post short update when we have 10m of data.

Ellen: i'll prototype a coalescer flag: ingress.coalesce_small_frames=true, params: max_frames=5, max_delay_ms=2. will measure impact on p50/p95.

Diego: i'll add kernel->kv_shard hit telemetry and a per-kernel shard-occupancy metric so selector can make locality-aware decisions.

perf-bot: [note] Created PERF-1512 "kernel-selector warmup affinity + ingress coalesce" and attached initial snapshots.

Marco: rollback complete. host p95 back to baseline within 8m. holding canary for 20m then will run A/B.

Priya: schedule a sync tomorrow 2026-03-24 16:00 UTC to review flamegraphs and decide next steps. keep all updates here. :thumbsup:
